summary:
Redesigned the top app badge and top section elements:
- Transformed the PWA install badge from a generic solid green button into an elegant frosted liquid-glass jewel capsule with a delicate champagne-gold hairline border, an ambient amber glimmer pip, and contemporary mobile iconography.
- Added localized text ('ایپ انسٹال کریں' in Urdu / 'Install App' in English).
- Enhanced the top header with a sacred Islamic geometric rosette (۞ Rub el Hizb), an ethereal gold ambient highlight along the lower seam, and a Maktab Ahlulbayt descriptor tag.
- Balanced the right-hand controls with matching twin liquid-glass capsules for app installation and app exit.
- Elevated the Welcome Masthead below the header with an ornamental Islamic geometric watermark, a gold highlight accent, a sacred diamond glyph (✦), and a glowing emerald recitation status jewel pill.
- Confirmed zero errors across linter, TypeScript compiler, and Vite build.
